data: Apple's operating income was about $114.3 billion in fiscal 2023 (the year ended September 30, 2023) and about $133.1 billion in fiscal 2025 (the year ended September 27, 2025). That is an increase of roughly $18.8 billion, or about 16.4%. The fiscal 2025 figure comes from my recollection of Apple's reported results, so please check it against the 10-K before relying on it. Over the same period, net sales rose from $383.3 billion to about $416.2 billion, or roughly 8.6%. Operating income therefore grew about twice as fast as revenue, and operating margin widened from about 29.8% to about 32%.
